TaxFAQ1.description: Find answers to common questions about our tax consulting services, process, and how we can help you with your financial needs.

items.question: What is tax consulting?
items.answer: Tax consulting involves professional advice and guidance to help individuals and businesses manage their tax obligations, reduce tax liabilities, and stay compliant with the latest tax laws and regulations. Our experts analyze your financial situation and provide customized strategies to optimize your tax planning.

items.question: Who can benefit from tax consulting services?
items.answer: Any individual, freelancer, startup founder, or enterprise looking to legally optimize taxes, file error-free ITR/GST returns, and avoid penalties can benefit significantly.

items.question: How can tax consulting help reduce my tax liability?
items.answer: By identifying all legitimate deductions under the Income Tax Act, restructuring salaries/expenses, and planning eligible investments before the financial year ends.

items.question: Do you help with GST registration and filing?
items.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end GST support, from fresh registrations to regular monthly/quarterly return filings (GSTR-1, 3B, 9) and Input Tax Credit reconciliation.

items.question: What documents are required for tax consulting?
items.answer: Typically PAN, Form 16/16A, bank statements, previous year ITR copies, and investment proof certificates.

items.question: How often should I consult a tax advisor?
items.answer: We recommend consulting before making major investments or property transactions, and at least quarterly for businesses to stay on top of advance tax deadlines.

items.question: Do you provide tax advisory for businesses?
items.answer: Yes, we offer complete corporate tax advisory, transfer pricing review, TDS compliance, and audit defense for private limited and LLP companies.

items.question: What are your consultation charges?
items.answer: Our pricing is completely transparent and tailored to your return type, transaction volume, or business turnover with no hidden fees.
